<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0">
<title>이지은 | LEE JI EUN</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..40,300;0,9..40,400;0,9..40,500;0,9..40,600;0,9..40,700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ── reset ── */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:300;background:#f9f8f5;color:#1c1c2e;line-height:1.75;overflow-x:hidden}
/* ── lightbox ── */
#lb{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.9);z-index:999;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;cursor:zoom-out}
#lb.on{display:flex}
#lb-box{position:relative;cursor:default;max-width:90vw;max-height:90vh}
#lb-img{max-width:100%;max-height:86vh;border-radius:8px;display:block;box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
#lb-x{position:absolute;top:-38px;right:0;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .2s}
#lb-x:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
/* ── header ── */
header{background:#0d1f35;color:#fff;padding:64px 40px 52px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
header::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-100px;right:-100px;width:440px;height:440px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,139,120,.2),transparent 65%);pointer-events:none}
header::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1a8b78,#25bfa8 45%,transparent)}
.h-wrap{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:28px;align-items:flex-start}
.h-photo{width:148px;height:148px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 15%;border:2.5px solid #25bfa8;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(37,191,168,.15);cursor:zoom-in;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;flex-shrink:0}
.h-photo:hover{transform:scale(1.03);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(37,191,168,.22)}
.h-name{font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(2.1rem,5.5vw,3.3rem);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:.02em}
.h-name em{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:clamp(.7rem,1.8vw,.82rem);letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#25bfa8;margin-top:8px;font-weight:400}
.h-degree{margin-top:12px;font-size:.85rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55)}
.h-degree strong{color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);font-weight:500}
.h-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:13px}
.h-tag{background:rgba(37,191,168,.13);border:1px solid rgba(37,191,168,.3);color:#25bfa8;font-size:.71rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.07em;padding:3px 11px;border-radius:20px}
.h-contact{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;padding-top:4px}
.h-contact-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.8rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);justify-content:flex-end}
.h-contact-row a{color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s}
.h-contact-row a:hover{color:#25bfa8}
.ci{width:14px;height:14px;fill:#25bfa8;flex-shrink:0}
/* ── main ── */
main{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:60px 40px 80px}
/* ── section ── */
.section{margin-bottom:52px}
.section-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:26px}
.section-head h2{font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;color:#0d1f35;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;white-space:nowrap}
.section-line{flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1a8b78,transparent)}
/* ── timeline ── */
.timeline-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:155px 1fr;gap:18px;padding:18px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eef1f0}
.timeline-row:first-child{padding-top:2px}
.timeline-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.t-date{font-size:.77rem;color:#1a8b78;line-height:1.6;padding-top:2px}
.t-info h3{font-size:.94rem;font-weight:500;color:#0d1f35;margin-bottom:3px}
.t-info p{font-size:.81rem;color:#6b7b8d;line-height:1.6}
.badge{display:inline-block;background:#e6f5f3;color:#1a8b78;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:500;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:4px;margin-top:6px}
/* ── skills ── */
.skills-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:13px}
.skill-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8e5;border-radius:10px;padding:18px;transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.skill-card:hover{border-color:#1a8b78;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(26,139,120,.09)}
.skill-card h3{font-size:.98rem;font-weight:700;color:#0d1f35;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:5px}
.skill-card p{font-size:.72rem;color:#6b7b8d;line-height:1.5}
.skill-bar{margin-top:11px;height:3px;background:#dce8e5;border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden}
.skill-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1a8b78,#25bfa8);border-radius:2px;animation:bar-in .9s ease both}
.skill-level{margin-top:6px;font-size:.7rem;color:#1a8b78;font-weight:500}
@keyframes bar-in{from{width:0!important}}
/* ── papers ── */
.paper{padding:16px 20px;background:#fff;border-left:3px solid #1a8b78;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.04);transition:border-left-width .2s,padding-left .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.paper:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.paper:hover{border-left-width:5px;padding-left:18px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(26,139,120,.1)}
.paper h3{font-size:.88rem;font-weight:400;font-style:italic;color:#0d1f35;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:7px;overflow-wrap:break-word;word-break:break-word}
.paper-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.paper-date{font-size:.72rem;color:#1a8b78;font-weight:500}
/* ── projects ── */
.projects{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
.project{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8e5;border-radius:10px;padding:16px 20px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;column-gap:13px;row-gap:5px;align-items:start;transition:box-shadow .2s}
.project:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(26,139,120,.09)}
.proj-org{background:#e6f5f3;color:#1a8b78;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:500;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:5px;white-space:nowrap;margin-top:1px}
.proj-body{min-width:0}
.proj-title{font-size:.85rem;color:#1c1c2e;line-height:1.65;overflow-wrap:break-word;word-break:keep-all}
.proj-period{font-size:.71rem;color:#6b7b8d;margin-top:3px}
.proj-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;align-items:flex-end}
.proj-role{background:#1a8b78;color:#fff;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:500;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:4px;white-space:nowrap}
/* ── shared button-link ── */
.btn-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:.7rem;color:#1a8b78;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;padding:2px 8px;border:1px solid #1a8b78;border-radius:4px;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.btn-link:hover{background:#1a8b78;color:#fff}
.btn-link svg{fill:currentColor;flex-shrink:0}
/* ── award ── */
.award{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e6f5f3,#fff 60%);border:1px solid #dce8e5;border-radius:10px;padding:20px 22px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.award-icon{width:44px;height:44px;background:#1a8b78;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
.award-text h3{font-size:.93rem;font-weight:500;color:#0d1f35}
.award-text p{font-size:.78rem;color:#6b7b8d;margin-top:2px}
/* ── certs ── */
.certs-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(148px,1fr));gap:10px}
.cert-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8e5;border-radius:8px;padding:13px 15px}
.cert-card h3{font-size:.86rem;font-weight:500;color:#0d1f35}
.cert-card p{font-size:.73rem;color:#6b7b8d;margin-top:2px;line-height:1.5}
.cert-card.lang-card{border-color:#1a8b78;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e6f5f3,#fff 80%)}
.lang-badge{display:inline-block;background:#0d1f35;color:#fff;font-size:.83rem;font-weight:700;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:5px;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:4px}
/* ── activities ── */
.conf-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
.conf-card{border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8e5;cursor:zoom-in;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.05);transition:box-shadow .2s,transform .2s}
.conf-card:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.11);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.conf-card img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 12%;display:block}
.conf-cap{padding:11px 14px}
.conf-badge{display:inline-block;background:#1a8b78;color:#fff;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:600;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:4px}
.conf-cap p{font-size:.76rem;color:#6b7b8d;line-height:1.5}
.poster-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:11px}
.poster-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8e5;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;cursor:zoom-in;transition:box-shadow .2s,transform .2s}
.poster-card:hover{box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(26,139,120,.11);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.poster-card img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;display:block}
.poster-info{padding:7px 9px}
.poster-info p{font-size:.66rem;color:#1c1c2e;line-height:1.45;overflow-wrap:break-word;word-break:break-word}
/* ── footer ── */
footer{background:#0d1f35;color:rgba(255,255,255,.38);text-align:center;padding:26px 20px;font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.05em}
/* ── fade-in animation ── */
@keyframes fade-up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.section{animation:fade-up .55s ease both}
.section:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.00s}.section:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.05s}
.section:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.10s}.section:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.15s}
.section:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.20s}.section:nth-child(6){animation-delay:.25s}
.section:nth-child(7){animation-delay:.30s}.section:nth-child(8){animation-delay:.35s}
.section:nth-child(9){animation-delay:.40s}
/* ── responsive ── */
@media(max-width:680px){
  header{padding:44px 18px 38px}
  .h-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}
  .h-photo{display:block;margin:0 auto 16px;width:116px;height:116px}
  .h-name{text-align:center;font-size:2.1rem}
  .h-name em{text-align:center}
  .h-degree{text-align:center}
  .h-tags{justify-content:center}
  .h-contact{align-items:flex-start;margin-top:18px}
  .h-contact-row{justify-content:flex-start}
  main{padding:40px 16px 60px}
  .timeline-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:3px}
  .t-date{padding-top:0}
  .skills-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .project{grid-template-columns:1fr;row-gap:7px}
  .proj-actions{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .conf-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .conf-card img{aspect-ratio:4/3}
  .poster-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .certs-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media(max-width:380px){
  .certs-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .poster-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- lightbox -->
<div id="lb">
  <div id="lb-box">
    <button id="lb-x">&#x2715;</button>
    <img id="lb-img" src="" alt="">
  </div>
</div>

<!-- header -->
<header>
  <div class="h-wrap">
    <img id="img-prof" class="h-photo" src="" alt="이지은 프로필">
    <div>
      <h1 class="h-name">이지은<em>Lee Ji Eun</em></h1>

        <span class="h-tag">분석</span>

      <div class="h-contact-row"><svg class="ci" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6.6 10.8c1.4 2.8 3.8 5.1 6.6 6.6l2.2-2.2c.28-.27.67-.36 1.02-.25C15.24 17.53 16.47 18 18 18c.55 0 1 .45 1 1v3.5c0 .55-.45 1-1 1C10.61 23.5 3.5 16.39 3.5 7.5c0-.55.45-1 1-1H8c.55 0 1 .45 1 1 0 1.25.2 2.45.57 3.57.11.35.03.74-.24 1.01l-2.2 2.2z"/></svg><span>010-5571-6735</span></div>
      <div class="h-contact-row"><svg class="ci" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2C8.13 2 5 5.13 5 9c0 5.25 7 13 7 13s7-7.75 7-13c0-3.87-3.13-7-7-7zm0 9.5c-1.38 0-2.5-1.12-2.5-2.5s1.12-2.5 2.5-2.5 2.5 1.12 2.5 2.5-1.12 2.5-2.5 2.5z"/></svg><span>부산광역시 해운대구</span></div>
      <div class="h-contact-row"><svg class="ci" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 11H7v2h2v-2zm4 0h-2v2h2v-2zm4 0h-2v2h2v-2zm2-7h-1V2h-2v2H8V2H6v2H5c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h14c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V6c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2zm0 16H5V9h14v11z"/></svg><span>1999.12.20 (만 26세)</span></div>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main>

<!-- 학력사항 -->
<section class="section">
  <div class="section-head"><h2>학력사항</h2><div class="section-line"></div></div>
  <div>
    <div class="timeline-row">
      <div class="t-date">2024.03 &#8212; 2026.02</div>
      <div class="t-info"><h3>국립부경대학교 &#183; 석사</h3><p>식품영양학과 &#183; 부산</p><span class="badge">4.41 / 4.5</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="timeline-row">
      <div class="t-date">2020.03 &#8212; 2024.02</div>
      <div class="t-info"><h3>국립부경대학교 &#183; 학사</h3><p>식품영양학과 &#183; 부산</p><span class="badge">3.86 / 4.5</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 경력사항 -->
<section class="section">
  <div class="section-head"><h2>경력사항</h2><div class="section-line"></div></div>
  <div>
    <div class="timeline-row" style="border-bottom:none;padding-top:2px">
      <div class="t-date">2026.03.10 &#8212;<br>현재</div>
      <div class="t-info"><h3>국립수산과학원</h3><p>식품안전가공과 &#183; 석사 후 연구원</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 보유 기술 -->
<section class="section">
  <div class="section-head"><h2>보유 기술</h2><div class="section-line"></div></div>
  <div class="skills-grid">
    <div class="skill-card">
      <h3>HPLC</h3><p>High Performance Liquid Chromatography</p>
      <div class="skill-bar"><div class="skill-fill" style="width:90%"></div></div>
      <p class="skill-level">기능 대부분 활용 가능</p>
    </div>
    <div class="skill-card">
      <h3>LC&#8209;MS</h3><p>Liquid Chromatography&#8211;Mass Spectrometry</p>
      <div class="skill-bar"><div class="skill-fill" style="width:90%"></div></div>
      <p class="skill-level">기능 대부분 활용 가능</p>
    </div>
    <div class="skill-card">
      <h3>GC&#8209;MS</h3><p>Gas Chromatography&#8211;Mass Spectrometry</p>
      <div class="skill-bar"><div class="skill-fill" style="width:55%"></div></div>
      <p class="skill-level">일부 기능 활용 가능</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 논문 -->
<section class="section">
  <div class="section-head"><h2>논문</h2><div class="section-line"></div></div>
  <div class="paper">
    <h3>Lipidomic Profiling&#8211;Based Identification of Novel Quality Markers Reflecting Freshness Changes in Triploid Oysters</h3>
    <div class="paper-meta">
      <span class="paper-date">2026.02</span>
      <a class="btn-link" href="https://m.riss.kr/search/download/FullTextDownload.do?control_no=40e7a0fb55e0a5deffe0bdc3ef48d419&p_mat_type=be54d9b8bc7cdb09&p_submat_type=f1a8c7a1de0e08b8&fulltext_kind=a8cb3aaead67ab5b&t_gubun=&convertFlag=&naverYN=&outLink=&nationalLibraryLocalBibno=&searchGubun=true&colName=bib_t&DDODFlag=&loginFlag=1&url_type=&query=Lipidomic+Profiling" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="currentColor"><path d="M14 3v2h3.59l-9.83 9.83 1.41 1.41L19 6.41V10h2V3h-7zm-9 2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-7h-2v7H5V7h7V5H5z"/></svg>링크</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="paper">
    <h3>The Influence of Solvent Choice on the Extraction of Bioactive Compounds from Asteraceae: A Comparative Review</h3>
    <div class="paper-meta">
      <span class="paper-date">2024.10</span>
      <a class="btn-link" href="https://doi.org/10.3390/foods13193151" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="currentColor"><path d="M14 3v2h3.59l-9.83 9.83 1.41 1.41L19 6.41V10h2V3h-7zm-9 2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-7h-2v7H5V7h7V5H5z"/></svg>링크</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 참여과제 -->
<section class="section">
  <div class="section-head"><h2>참여과제</h2><div class="section-line"></div></div>
  <div class="projects">
    <div class="project">
      <span class="proj-org">한국연구재단</span>
      <div class="proj-body"><p class="proj-title">해양 미세플라스틱의 어류내 축적에 따른 위해성 평가</p><p class="proj-period">2024.09.01 &#8212; 2025.08.31</p></div>
      <div class="proj-actions"><span class="proj-role">책임연구원</span><a class="btn-link" href="https://n.news.naver.com/mnews/article/082/0001288017?sid=102" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="currentColor"><path d="M14 3v2h3.59l-9.83 9.83 1.41 1.41L19 6.41V10h2V3h-7zm-9 2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-7h-2v7H5V7h7V5H5z"/></svg>링크</a></div>
    </div>
    <div class="project">

<script>
(function(){
  var jfif='data:image/jpeg;base64,';
  var src={
    prof: jfif+'',
    imbc: jfif+'',
    ksfs: jfif+'',
    p0:   jfif+'',
    p1:   jfif+'',
    p2:   jfif+'',
    p3:   jfif+''
  };
  var ids={prof:'img-prof',imbc:'img-imbc',ksfs:'img-ksfs',p0:'img-p0',p1:'img-p1',p2:'img-p2',p3:'img-p3'};
  for(var k in ids){var e=document.getElementById(ids[k]);if(e)e.src=src[k];}

  var lb=document.getElementById('lb');
  var lbImg=document.getElementById('lb-img');
  function open(s){lbImg.src=s;lb.classList.add('on');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';}
  function close(){lb.classList.remove('on');document.body.style.overflow='';setTimeout(function(){lbImg.src='';},250);}
  document.getElementById('lb-x').addEventListener('click',close);
  lb.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===lb)close();});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')close();});
  document.getElementById('img-prof').addEventListener('click',function(){open(src.prof);});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-zoom]').forEach(function(el){
    el.addEventListener('click',function(){
      var img=el.querySelector('img');
      if(img&&img.src&&img.src!==window.location.href)open(img.src);
    });
  });
}());
</script>
